release_notes: Factburst Link Tracker now defaults to https://go.factburstquiz.com, and existing settings using the legacy go.factburstquiz.workers.dev address migrate automatically in the app.
Tracking links created for new promos now use the branded go.factburstquiz.com domain once that Worker custom domain is active.

Upgraded Generate + Schedule to Generate + Autopilot: new quiz batches keep running through tracking creation, website preparation, and the batch promo-scheduling step after the full videos are scheduled.
Logo and other visual-question media are copied into each newly generated quiz project before promo creation, so logo quiz promo Shorts keep the actual logo artwork.
Autopilot keeps the remaining manual work focused on platform limitations such as Instagram publishing and YouTube Shorts Related video setup.
